comment_box: No change is required to current VA health care policy.  Women in the military, active and retired MUST HAVE full coverage of all medical needs, to include reproductively.   The proposed change will also affect spouses of military members. The change to ideology by a few from evidence-based medical care and will cause irreparable harm to veterans. The 2024 Watson study by Jennifer Greenberg shows the impact of sexual assault as a cost of war and the blatant discrimination suffered by veterans who still fight to be recognized as full front line combat participants.  Personally, I worked for the Department of Defense (Army, Air Guard and OSD), for a total of 38 years and am the proud mother of a retired active duty daughter who was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, and South Korea.
